title: A Murdered King's Gold Chain, in the Suspect's Family #shorts
description:
A 1516 will mentions a gold chain that belonged to Edward V, one of the Princes in the Tower. The widow's sister was married to James Tyrrell, the man Thomas More named as organizer of the murder. Suggestive, not proof.

Full investigation on the channel: Did Richard III Kill the Princes in the Tower? I'm 49% Sure

Source: Thornton, T. (2024), History 109. Image: Northcote (c. 1805), public domain.
